# ML-09: Time-Series Machine Learning (Tier 2)

**Subtrack:** Machine Learning Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Lag features, leakage-free temporal validation, global models, sequence models and anomaly detection on streams.

**Tier note:** Tier 1 has a single assessment because foundational time-series reasoning is covered in DS-10. The ML unit concentrates on modelling at Tiers 2 and 3.
